claim: In a frame-locked game a small lateness costs a whole frame, so judge lateness per update and bias long windows fast.

evidence.text: A few ms at the start of a run moved the slowest 20 updates from +2.6% to +20.9% with no slower code.
When the handler overruns two frames the update takes three, so a few hundred T moves whole updates.
Cut only until the late tail fits: hook time fell 12% and lost frames went 38 to 8.
